description: RME MADIface USB series driver (WDM/ASIO) with TotalMix FX, for Fireface UFX II / UFX III / UFX+, ADI-2 series, Digiface, MADIface, OctaMic XTC and USB.IO.
notes: SYSTEM DRIVER. NOT unattended: RME's Driver Install Wizard is interactive and requires UAC elevation.
Requires Windows 10 (1709) or newer, x64 or Arm64. Installs to C:\Program Files\RME\MADIface and bundles TotalMix FX 1.991.
Uninstall by running '$dir\rmeinstaller.exe' and choosing Uninstall. RME does not support uninstalling from Windows 'Apps & features', and 'scoop uninstall' does not remove the driver.
For Babyface, Fireface UC / UCX / UCX II / UFX / 802 use 'rme-fireface-usb-driver' instead.
